The Difference Between a Setup and a Guarantee

Even a clean chart pattern can fail. Professional-style analysis starts with a clear idea, defines what would invalidate that idea, and accepts that the market can do something else. This mindset keeps you focused on process instead of pretending to know the future. The goal is not certainty. The goal is disciplined decision-making under uncertainty.

TRADING IS NOT FOR THOSE WHO DON'T HAVE PATIENCE.  LEARN | TRADE | EARN
